mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tbl_user_mission_info WHERE assign_date = #{assignDate} AND result = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id

SELECT assignment.id AS assignment_id, assignment.user_id, assignment.assign_date, assignment.target_value, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN mission_transaction.is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(mission_transaction.refunded_amount, mission_transaction.amount) ELSE mission_transaction.amount END ), 0) AS current_amount FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment JOIN tbl_mission_pool mission ON mission.id = assignment.mission_id LEFT JOIN tbl_transaction mission_transaction ON mission_transaction.user_id = assignment.user_id AND mission_transaction.category_id = mission.category_id AND mission_transaction.tr_date = assignment.assign_date AND mission_transaction.classification = 'CONSUMPTION' AND mission_transaction.direction = 'OUT' AND mission_transaction.is_excluded_from_summary = 0 WHERE assignment.id = #{assignmentId} AND assignment.result = 'PENDING' GROUP BY assignment.id, assignment.user_id, assignment.assign_date, assignment.target_value FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_streak_count (user_id, streak_count, longest_streak_count, last_check_date) SELECT #{userId}, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN streak.last_success_date = latest.last_result_date THEN streak.streak_length ELSE 0 END), 0), COALESCE(MAX(streak.streak_length), 0), #{checkedAt} FROM ( SELECT MAX(assign_date) AS last_result_date FROM tbl_user_mission_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') ) latest LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MAX(success.assign_date) AS last_success_date, COUNT(*) AS streak_length FROM ( SELECT assign_date, DATE_SUB(assign_date, INTERVAL ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY assign_date) DAY) AS streak_group FROM tbl_user_mission_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND result = 'SUCCESS' ) success GROUP BY success.streak_group ) streak ON 1 = 1 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE streak_count = VALUES(streak_count), longest_streak_count = VALUES(longest_streak_count), last_check_date = #{checkedAt}
